title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
abstract: arXiv:2610.37914v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000

translated_title: Muon 使第一个混合专家层更难保持负载均衡
translated_abstract: 许多开源的混合专家语言模型使用 Muon 而非 AdamW 进行训练。大多数模型通过在每位专家的路由分数上施加一个偏置来平衡负载，该偏置在每一步训练后都会调整。各种训练方案在“Muon 是否也应训练路由器”这一问题上存在分歧。在活跃参数量为 55M 和 108M 的模型中，我们测量了优化器如何改变这些偏置的跨度（即一层内最大值减去最小值）。当所有 token 都偏向相同的专家时，该跨度会增大，因此它可以反映某一层的负载均衡难度。在根据较短训练调整的学习率下，Muon 在每个随机种子下都增大了第一个 MoE 层的偏置跨度，平均约翻倍，而其他层的变化则小得多。这一增长源于 Muon 作用于网络的其余部分，与路由器由哪种优化器训练无关。在这些运行中，第一个路由器的输入共享同一个方向，且在预热结束后不久，其最繁忙的专家平均承担了其公平份额的四到七倍。在最初的 3000 个……
tldr: 研究发现 Muon 优化器会使混合专家语言模型第一个 MoE 层的路由偏置跨度平均翻倍，导致该层负载严重失衡（最繁忙专家承担四到七倍公平份额），且这一效应源于 Muon 对网络其余部分的作用而与路由器的训练方式无关。
en_tdlr: Muon roughly doubles the routing-bias span of the first MoE layer in mixture-of-experts language models, causing severe load imbalance where the busiest expert takes four to seven times its fair share, and this effect stems from Muon on the rest of the network regardless of which optimizer trains the router.
